title: Pilot-to-production readiness criteria and cross-functional runbook
creator: Sanjay Mehta
description: Purpose: Provide a single, executable runbook for taking a pilot cohort (10-25 enterprise or mid-market customers) through staged launches to dedicated beta and then to general availability. Scope includes cross-team deliverables (Eng, SRE, Product, Design, Sales, CS, Legal, Security), release notes coordination, success criteria, telemetry and feedback loops, and go/no-go gating. This ticket captures readiness criteria, a timeline, and a playbook of actions owners must complete before each stage (pilot, lighthouse, ramp, GA). Background: multiple previous pilot rollouts had inconsistent instrumentations and unclear release-note ownership; this creates template-driven consistency and prevents regressions in quality or communication.
acceptance_criteria: All pilot customers have signed opt-in agreements (legal template v1.2) and are listed in the pilot roster
Telemetry events for latency, errors, token usage, and model-fallbacks are instrumented and visualized in the pilot dashboard
Release notes draft has been produced, reviewed by Eng and Legal, and scheduled for distribution to pilot customers
Canary routing and automatic fallback policies are validated in staging and smoke-tested against synthetic traffic
Success criteria and rollback thresholds documented and approved (SLO violation, user-reported regressions, cost spike thresholds)
Cross-functional readiness meeting (Eng, SRE, Product, CS, Sales, Security) completed with explicit owners for all open action items
runbook_steps: T-28d: Confirm pilot cohort and sign NDAs/opt-in. Owner: Sales (Emma Liu). Deliverable: pilot_roster.csv uploaded to Drive.
T-21d: Legal to verify opt-in language and privacy checklist. Owner: Legal (Marco Diaz). Deliverable: signed template link to Drive.
T-14d: Instrument telemetry events: request_id, model_variant, latency_ms, error_code, kv_cache_hit, billing_tokens. Owner: Eng (Ravi Patel). Deliverable: telemetry PR and staging dashboard link.
T-10d: Run smoke tests against canary routing with synthetic payloads and validate fallback behavior. Owner: SRE (Olivia Park). Deliverable: smoke test report and failure-mode runbook.
T-7d: Draft release notes and customer communication: feature summary, known issues, support contacts, opt-out instructions. Owner: Product (Aisha Clarke) with review from Eng and Legal.
T-5d: Conduct cross-functional readiness review; capture open items and owners. Owner: Product. Deliverable: readiness_review_notes.md.
Launch window (Pilot start): enable feature flag for pilot tenants, monitor initial 72h at 15-minute cadence, and escalate on SLO breaches. Owner: SRE and CS.
Post-pilot (T+14d): run qualitative feedback sessions with each pilot account, record issues and feature-requests in PM backlog, and prioritize fixes. Owner: CS/Product.

Ramp decision point (T+21d): evaluate success metrics (usage, NPS, incident rate, cost delta). If pass, schedule Lighthouse cohort and update release notes for a wider audience. Owner: Product and GTM.
GA readiness (T+45d after successful ramp): finalize documentation, SDK changelogs, operator upgrade guides, and prepare public release notes. Owner: Product with Eng and Docs.
Post-GA: establish 90-day monitoring plan and periodic quality checkpoints for model regressions. Owner: Product and Research.
monitoring_kpis: 99th percentile inference latency (target < 200ms for short prompts)
Customer satisfaction: pilot NPS >= 30 and CS qualitative score >= 4/5
release_notes_plan: Owner: Product (primary) + Eng (technical details) + Legal (compliance language)
Draft timeline: initial pilot note -> lighthouse update -> GA notes. Each draft due 7 days before the next phase.
Sections required: short summary, breaking changes (none expected), migration steps, telemetry changes, known limitations, support contacts, opt-out instructions.
Distribution channels: direct email to pilot roster, Console in-app banner for lighthouse, public docs and changelog on GA day.
Sign-off matrix: Eng lead, SRE, Legal, Security, and PM must sign off on each major release note version before distribution. Signatures captured in readiness_review_notes.md.
Coordinate with Marketing for messaging cadence and with Sales to prepare customer talking points (FAQ and objection handling).
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Missing telemetry causes blindspots. Mitigation: Block GA until telemetry coverage checklist is 100% complete; use synthetic traffic to validate event surfaces.
Risk: Cost spike from unexpected token growth. Mitigation: set automatic throttle policy and spend alert at 20% above forecast; if triggered, throttle non-essential routes and notify GTM.
Risk: Regulatory concerns from pilot customers. Mitigation: require Legal sign-off and KMS/HSM review for any data ingestion workflows prior to pilot onboarding.
Risk: Support capacity overwhelmed. Mitigation: schedule dedicated CS office hours for pilot customers and pre-prepare triage playbooks for top 5 expected issues.
